entities.name: Eight-and-a-Half-Tails
entities.description: Highest spiritual leader of the kitsune on Kamigawa, who cut off half a tail in penance.

entities.name: Iron-Claw
entities.description: His apprentice who became a samurai and died.

entities.name: Konda
entities.description: Daimyo who requested research on the kakuriyo and committed a crime.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: War for which he felt indirectly responsible.

entities.name: Kakuriyo
entities.description: Spirit world researched at Konda's request.

events.summary: As a child he gains tails by rescuing a friend and easing a samurai's death, deciding to become a cleric.
events.quote: he received his third tail after easing a samurai's death and deciding to become a cleric

events.summary: He saves three-quarters of Hagi Village from plague.
events.quote: After saving three-quarters of Hagi Village from a plague, he received his sixth tail

events.summary: He accepts Iron-Claw leaving to become a samurai.
events.quote: he accepted Iron-Claw's departure gracefully despite his misgivings

events.summary: He is elevated to spiritual leader of all kitsune and gains his ninth tail.
events.quote: His ninth and final tail came when he was elevated to his position as spiritual leader of all kitsune on Kamigawa.

events.summary: His research for Konda makes him indirectly responsible for Konda's crime, the Kami War and Iron-Claw's death.
events.quote: he became indirectly responsible for Konda's crime and the Kami War

events.summary: As penance he cuts off half of a tail and becomes Eight-and-a-Half-Tails.
events.quote: he cut off half of one of his tails with a ceremonial knife

relations.quote: was the highest spiritual leader of the kitsune on the plane of Kamigawa

relations.note: researched the kakuriyo at his request
relations.quote: Upon the request of daimyo Konda
